title: Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methods for Classification: A Comparative Study with Classical Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.42029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are the most concrete near-term proposal for quantum machine learning on classical data, yet published benchmarks disagree on whether they outperform tuned classical kernels, and the disagreement cannot be resolved from the literature because the comparisons are not protocol-controlled. We argue that the obstacle is one of measurement, not theory: the usual setup fixes the quantum feature map's data scaling while grid-searching the classical kernel's hyperparameters, recomputes nothing per fold, and reports cost in simulator time. We therefore treat the comparison itself as the object of study and impose three controls. The bandwidth is tuned on the same grid budget as the classical $\gamma$, the kernel is recomputed inside every fold from fold-fitted preprocessing, and cost is counted in hardware circuit evaluations. translated_title: 量子核方法用于分类的实证评估：与经典核的对比研究
translated_abstract: 量子核方法是近期在经典数据上实现量子机器学习最具体的方案，然而已发表的基准测试对量子核是否能超越经过调优的经典核存在分歧，且由于这些比较未受协议控制，无法从文献中解决这一争议。我们认为障碍在于测量方法而非理论本身：通常的实验设置在网格搜索经典核超参数的同时固定了量子特征映射的数据缩放，不在每一折内重新计算核，并以模拟器时间报告成本。因此，我们将比较本身作为研究对象，施加三项控制：带宽在与经典核参数γ相同的网格预算下调优，核在每个折内部基于按折拟合的预处理重新计算，成本以硬件电路评估次数计算。在此之上，我们运行了一个包含324个单元的因子设计，其中维度、训练规模……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文将量子核与经典核的比较本身作为研究对象，通过三项协议控制（同等网格预算下调优带宽、每折内重算核、以硬件电路评估次数计量成本）和324个单元的因子设计，对量子核方法在分类任务中的表现进行了公平的实证评估。
en_tdlr: This paper treats the quantum-versus-classical kernel comparison itself as the object of study, imposing three protocol controls (bandwidth tuned on the same grid budget, per-fold kernel recomputation, cost counted in hardware circuit evaluations) and a 324-cell factorial design to empirically evaluate quantum kernel methods for classification.
